description: Subject-to-MetaDimension contribution matrix based on educational psychology research

manifold_fluidity.description: Ability to move fluidly between conceptual states

identity_elasticity.description: Adaptability to new contexts and self-concept flexibility
identity_elasticity.high: Comfortable trying new things, growth mindset
identity_elasticity.low: Rigid identity, fear of looking incompetent

gradient_awareness.high: Knows what they're improving at, calibrated self-assessment

entropy_intuition.description: Comfort with uncertainty and productive exploration

cooperative_generativity.high: Builds on others' ideas, co-creates naturally
cooperative_generativity.low: Isolated thinking, competitive rather than collaborative

math.description: Mathematical reasoning, numerical fluency, and abstract problem-solving

research_basis.gradient_awareness: Mathematical problem-solving requires constant self-monitoring of approach efficacy (Schoenfeld, 1992)
research_basis.multi_model_coherence: Translating between representations (algebraic, geometric, numerical) builds cross-domain integration (Duval, 2006)

problem_solving.research_basis: Novel problem-solving requires flexible strategy switching (Polya, 1945)

proof_writing.research_basis: Proof construction requires holding multiple logical threads simultaneously (Weber, 2001)

collaborative_math.research_basis: Mathematical discourse communities enhance conceptual understanding (Lampert, 1990)

estimation.research_basis: Estimation requires comfort with inexact answers (Sowder, 1992)

reading.description: Reading comprehension, literary analysis, and text interpretation

research_basis.identity_elasticity: Perspective-taking through literature develops identity flexibility (Mar & Oatley, 2008)
research_basis.non_dual_resolution: Literary interpretation often requires holding multiple valid readings (Rosenblatt, 1978)

literary_analysis.description: Analyzing themes, symbols, and narrative structure
literary_analysis.research_basis: Complex texts support multiple valid interpretations requiring dialectical thinking

perspective_taking.research_basis: Theory of mind development through narrative (Kidd & Castano, 2013)

close_reading.research_basis: Metacognitive monitoring during reading comprehension (Baker & Brown, 1984)

book_discussions.research_basis: Dialogic discussion builds collaborative meaning-making (Reznitskaya et al., 2001)

science.description: Scientific inquiry, experimentation, and evidence-based reasoning

research_basis.entropy_intuition: Scientific method embraces uncertainty through hypothesis testing (Popper, 1959)
research_basis.multi_model_coherence: Science requires integrating observations, theories, and mathematical models (Giere, 1988)

experimentation.research_basis: Experimental design requires comfort with unexpected results (Chinn & Malhotra, 2002)

data_analysis.research_basis: Statistical reasoning involves embracing variability (Wild & Pfannkuch, 1999)

model_building.research_basis: Model-based reasoning requires flexibility in representation (Lehrer & Schauble, 2006)

lab_collaboration.description: Working in lab teams on investigations

coding.description: Programming, computational thinking, and software development

research_basis.gradient_awareness: Debugging requires constant metacognitive monitoring of program state (Perkins et al., 1986)
research_basis.manifold_fluidity: Programmers shift between abstraction levels continuously (Lister et al., 2004)

debugging.research_basis: Debugging is metacognition made visible (McCauley et al., 2008)

algorithm_design.research_basis: Algorithm design requires flexible problem decomposition (Wing, 2006)

pair_programming.research_basis: Pair programming enhances learning through verbalization (Williams & Kessler, 2000)

code_review.research_basis: Code review develops critical analysis of multiple approaches

open_source_contribution.research_basis: Open source requires navigating unfamiliar codebases and community norms

study_skills.description: Learning strategies, time management, and self-regulation

research_basis.identity_elasticity: Growth mindset is core to effective study habits (Dweck, 2006)

spaced_repetition.research_basis: Effective spacing requires calibrated memory confidence (Cepeda et al., 2006)

study_groups.research_basis: Peer explanation enhances understanding (Chi et al., 1989)

critical_thinking.description: Logical reasoning, argument analysis, and evaluation

research_basis.non_dual_resolution: Critical thinking requires evaluating competing claims (Ennis, 1985)
research_basis.multi_model_coherence: Argument mapping integrates multiple reasoning chains (van Gelder, 2005)

argument_analysis.research_basis: Argument mapping enhances critical thinking (van Gelder, 2005)

source_evaluation.research_basis: Source evaluation requires calibrated uncertainty (Wineburg & McGrew, 2017)

socratic_dialogue.research_basis: Socratic questioning develops intellectual humility (Paul & Elder, 2006)

technology.description: Digital literacy, tool proficiency, and tech fluency

research_basis.entropy_intuition: Technology requires comfort with constant change and troubleshooting (Prensky, 2001)
research_basis.manifold_fluidity: Digital natives switch between tools and interfaces fluidly (Jenkins, 2006)

tool_exploration.research_basis: Tool learning requires adaptive expertise (Hatano & Inagaki, 1986)

online_collaboration.description: Working with others through digital tools
online_collaboration.research_basis: Online collaboration requires coordinating multiple communication channels

problem_solving.description: General problem-solving, heuristics, and strategic thinking

research_basis.manifold_fluidity: Expert problem solvers switch strategies flexibly (Chi et al., 1988)
research_basis.entropy_intuition: Effective problem solving requires productive struggle (Kapur, 2008)

real_world_problems.research_basis: Real problems lack clear solution paths (Jonassen, 2000)

art.description: Visual arts, creative expression, and aesthetic development

research_basis.identity_elasticity: Art-making develops self-expression and identity exploration (Hetland et al., 2007)
research_basis.entropy_intuition: Visual arts embrace ambiguity and multiple interpretations (Eisner, 2002)
research_basis.manifold_fluidity: Artists shift between global and local perspectives (Winner et al., 2013)

sculpture_3d.research_basis: Sculpture requires spatial reasoning across viewpoints

art_critique.research_basis: Art criticism develops tolerance for ambiguity (Housen, 2002)

collaborative_art.research_basis: Collaborative art requires negotiating aesthetic choices

digital_art.research_basis: Digital art bridges traditional and computational thinking

music.description: Music theory, performance, composition, and appreciation

research_basis.manifold_fluidity: Musicians develop enhanced cognitive flexibility (Hanna-Pladdy & MacKay, 2011)
research_basis.multi_model_coherence: Music integrates auditory, motor, visual, and emotional processing (Zatorre et al., 2007)
research_basis.cooperative_generativity: Ensemble playing requires real-time coordination (D'Ausilio et al., 2012)

ensemble_performance.description: Playing in groups, bands, or orchestras

improvisation.research_basis: Musical improvisation engages executive function and default mode network (Limb & Braun, 2008)

composition.research_basis: Composition integrates theory, emotion, and structure

music_theory.research_basis: Music theory bridges mathematical and aesthetic reasoning

active_listening.research_basis: Active listening develops attention and emotional regulation (Kramer et al., 2009)

physical_education.description: Physical activity, body awareness, sports, and movement

research_basis.gradient_awareness: Physical activity provides immediate biofeedback on effort and performance (Ratey, 2008)
research_basis.identity_elasticity: Sports develop resilience and growth mindset through failure and recovery (Dweck, 2006)

individual_sports.research_basis: Individual sports develop self-monitoring and personal responsibility

team_sports.research_basis: Team sports require real-time coordination and role flexibility (Eccles & Tenenbaum, 2004)

martial_arts.research_basis: Martial arts develop mind-body integration and self-discipline (Lakes & Hoyt, 2004)

yoga_mindfulness.research_basis: Contemplative practices develop interoceptive awareness (Farb et al., 2015)

dance.research_basis: Dance integrates movement, music, and expression (Karpati et al., 2015)

outdoor_adventure.research_basis: Outdoor experiences develop adaptability and risk assessment (Ewert & Yoshino, 2011)

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Pattern recognition transfer - both domains involve hierarchical pattern structures (Spelke, 2008)
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Temporal pattern recognition in music transfers to mathematical sequence understanding

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Design thinking + scientific method share iterative uncertainty tolerance (Cross, 2011)
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Both disciplines embrace productive failure as part of the creative/discovery process

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Narrative imagination combined with visual expression deepens perspective-taking
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Creating visual interpretations of literary works exercises identity flexibility

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Both involve formal symbol systems mapping to experiential outcomes (Papert, 1980)
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Algorithmic composition bridges computational and aesthetic reasoning

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Physical feedback literacy transfers to cognitive self-monitoring (Diamond, 2000)
Literary analysis + logical reasoning develop dialectical thinking
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Evaluating competing interpretations strengthens comfort with ambiguity

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Multimodal arts collaboration enhances creative co-construction (Sawyer, 2012)
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Cross-arts projects require negotiating multiple aesthetic frameworks

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Computational science requires tracking both code and experimental state
Embodied cognition research shows physical strategies transfer to abstract thinking (Wilson, 2002)
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Physical problem-solving (sports tactics) develops strategic flexibility

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Digital creation tools enable identity experimentation (Turkle, 2011)
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Creating digital personas and avatars exercises self-concept flexibility

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Rhythmic and harmonic ratios connect auditory and mathematical reasoning (Large, 2010)
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Music theory's mathematical foundations bridge domains

cross_subject_synergies.research_basis: Both require evaluating evidence under uncertainty
cross_subject_synergies.mechanism: Scientific skepticism combined with logical analysis develops calibrated uncertainty

developmental_modifiers.notes: Younger learners benefit more from concrete/embodied activities (art, music, PE). Older learners can leverage abstract activities (critical thinking, coding).

elementary.research_basis: Embodied and artistic learning is developmentally primary (Piaget, 1952)

middle_school.research_basis: Adolescents benefit from both abstract and embodied learning

high_school.research_basis: Formal operational thinking enables fuller academic engagement (Piaget, 1952)

engagement_quality_modifiers.description: Adjustments based on quality of engagement
engagement_quality_modifiers.research_basis: ICAP framework - Interactive > Constructive > Active > Passive (Chi & Wylie, 2014)
